auth.title: Sign in to Fleetwright
auth.subtitle: Operators sign in with email, password and a TOTP code.
auth.prototypeNote: Prototype: nothing is checked or sent. Any well-formed input continues.
auth.mfaSubtitle: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Fleetwright.

errors.code: Enter the 6 digits from your authenticator app.
errors.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
errors.expired: That step expired. Start again with your email and password.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

auth.lockoutNote: After 5 failed codes the account locks for 15 minutes (planned behaviour).
auth.liveNote: Your password and code go only to this site's API. Repeated failed attempts lock sign-in for a while.

demo.title: Try the public demo
demo.body: A shared demo login with limited controls. The code below is today's current code; it changes every 30 seconds.

auth.browse: Or browse the public demo without signing in

agent.title: Fleetwright Agent
agent.subtitle: Runs locally against your own Chrome. Asks before it publishes, sends or buys.
agent.scriptedReply: Noted. (Prototype: replies are scripted; the real agent arrives in Phase 4.)
agent.untrustedNote: Page text is treated as untrusted data — it can never approve its own actions.

messages.text: Draft a launch post for the Demo Studio page from the product brief, then publish it.
I opened the brief, the Demo Studio page and your calendar in three tabs. Draft is ready — I've labelled it as AI-generated. Publishing needs your approval.

queue.preview: We're launching the Demo Studio spring collection on 14 Oct. Built in-house, shipped in small batches. (Labelled: AI-assisted draft)

board.name: Demo Freight Exchange
board.tagline: A fictitious load board built for the Fleetwright demo. Not a real marketplace.
board.otpBody: We sent a 6-digit code to the dispatch mailbox. In production, Fleetwright's mailbox connector reads it.
board.feedNote: New loads appear in real time. Book fast — so does everyone else.
board.confirmBody: You are committing your carrier to this load at the posted rate.
board.captchaBody: The board asks a human to confirm this booking. Fleetwright never solves captchas automatically — an operator answers here, or the claim pauses.
board.captchaLabel: I'm booking this load on behalf of my carrier
board.successBody: Confirmation {ref}. This is the event the reconciler checks after a crash.
board.takenBody: Another carrier booked this load first. This is the race Fleetwright's single lease prevents inside one fleet.
